$WILD STAKING AND LP FARMING HAVE BEEN SUPER CHARGED      

  Greetings Wilders  

  We are thrilled to announce that we have supercharged our staking rewards for $WILD staking and LP farming by an incredible 3x!  

 What is $WILD Token Staking?
$WILD tokens are deposited onto the Wilder World staking portal to progressively earn $WILD token rewards.
,
Your initial investment is not locked, allowing you the flexibility to make deposits and withdrawals as you wish.
,
Once your $WILD tokens are staked, you can view your rewards by connecting your wallet to the portal and accessing the ‘My Deposits’ page.
,
Rewards can be claimed anytime, but note that each claim transaction will incur gas fees.
,
Once claimed, the rewards are locked in the staking pool for 12 months. However, your initial $WILD deposits can be withdrawn at any time.
,
Rewards can be withdrawn after the 12-month lock period.
,

 What is LP Farming?
With LP farming,  liquidity is provided to the pool by depositing equal dollar values of WILD and WETH on Uniswap.
,
In return for providing liquidity, you receive LP tokens. These LP tokens represent your share in the pool and act as a receipt for your deposit.
,
As with single $WILD staking, the $WILD rewards earnerd are locked in the single staking pool for 12 months once claimed.
,
Rewards can be withdrawn after the 12-month lock period.
,
Your LP tokens can be withdrawn at any time.
,
LP staking offers a higher APR compared to single $WILD staking but comes with the potential risk of impermanent loss.
,

  APR
The APR is as follows (as of Saturday, June 8th, 2024 at 4PM PT):

$WILD staking: 11.14%
,
LP Farming: 216.25%
,
Check out the staking site for current APR: https://app.wilderworld.com/staking/pools

  SNAPSHOT DATE AND TIME:  Wednesday, August 21, 2024 at 8:00 AM

  IMPORTANT REMINDER: INFORMATION FOR CHAIN HOLDERS  
  The snapshot will implement a forced max-chain approach, meaning the system will automatically recognise the longest possible chain by default. For instance, if you hold a 6-chain, it will be identified as a single 6-chain, rather than as two separate 3-chains.

  If as a 6-chain holder, you would prefer to receive rewards for holding two separate Trinities instead of one longer chain, you must split your 6-chain into two separate Trinities, by placing them in different wallets before the snapshot is taken.

  The same principle applies to smaller chains: the snapshot will recognise any longer chain by default!

   Consider this example: 
  You hold two Trinities in your wallet, but each Trinity is not formed with the same three industry assets:
 Trinity 1: Wolf, Wheel, Moto
 Trinity 2: Wolf, Wheel, Craft

  By default, the snapshot will recognise the longest chain, which in this case would be a 4-Chain:
  4-Chain: Wolf, Wheel, Moto, craft
  Leftover Assets: You would then be left with one spare Wolf and one spare Wheel.
  In this case, you would need to split your Trinities into two different wallets before the snapshot is taken, if you would prefer to receive rewards for holding two Trinities rather than rewards for a 4-chain.

  You can use the incredible Trinityzer developed by our talented community member @fc12345_ to better understand how we will be reading Chains:

THE GENESIS LAND AIRDROP HAS BEEN INITIATED

  We’re thrilled to announce that the Genesis Land airdrop, our most anticipated collection yet, has been initiated!! Eligible Trinity Keepers can check their wallets as Genesis Land Title NFTs are being distributed. NFTs are being minted one by one, so it may take some time before NFTs appear in all wallets. Each title serves as official proof of ownership, complete with details about the unique plot of Land you own on The Island.

  Genesis Land Drop Overview   

Location: The Island
,
Quantity: 4,444 Land Titles
,
Chain: Ethereum L1
,
Eligibility: Eligible Trinity Keepers were captured in a snapshot on Wednesday, August 21, 2024, at 12:00 UTC. Trinities formed after the snapshot are not eligible for the Genesis Land airdrop. Wilders can however purchase Land on the secondary market.

Utility: In-world utility, providing essential functions and experiences within Wilder World via residential, commercial, industrial, and mixed-use zones.

 Genesis Land - Full details & Rarity

THE WHEELS DAO PROPOSAL 

  Greetings Wilders   

  We’re thrilled to announce an important proposal to activate MMED with the launch of our next major game release, by swapping ETH for WILD within the Wheels DAO.

 INTRODUCTION
As initially outlined in the ‘Wheels Industry Rewards’ section of Dev Log X, we are submitting a formal DAO proposal to swap 80% of the ETH holdings within the Wheels DAO for WILD. This strategic move aims to bolster Wilder World’s growing economy by supporting in-game rewards for Wheels gameplay and enabling Wheels Industry Staking. This proposal will activate MMED rewards within Metropolis, allowing Wheels holders to earn WILD through racing while fueling the Wheels Industry Staking system.

  Why is this important?
This swap is crucial for ensuring the long-term sustainability of Wilder Wheels’ gameplay rewards and staking system, providing exclusive benefits for Wheels holders and strengthening our in-game economy.

 Rollout of Wheels Industry Rewards
The Wheels Industry Rewards will be introduced over three proposals:
  Step 1: Proposal to allocate 80% of the Wheels DAO’s ETH to MMED and swap it to WILD (this proposal).
  Step 2: Proposal to allocate a percentage of MMED assets to Racing Rewards and Industry Staking.
  Step 3: Proposal to allocate a percentage of Racing Rewards between Wheels owners and non-owners.

 Benefits of the ETH to WILD Swap
Kickstarting the Economy: Supports the WILD economy by implementing racing rewards and NFT staking within the Wheels industry.
,
Enables MMED Rewards: Unlocks WILD rewards exclusively for Wheels holders through racing gameplay.
,
Supports Wheels Industry Staking: Fuels the Wheels Industry Staking, offering Wheels holders a passive rewards system in Wilder World.
,

 EXECUTION DETAILS 
ETH to WILD Swap
A DAO proposal for the Wheels DAO will be initiated to swap 80% of the current ETH in the Wheels DAO for WILD. If approved, the swap will be for 1,650.112 ETH of the 2,062.64 ETH in the Wheels DAO.

  WILD Allocation
There will be a future proposal breaking down the specifics on how the WILD will be utilised for MMED and Wheels Industry staking.

  Pros & Cons:
  Pros
Empowers the WILD economy, enabling faucets and sinks.
,
Provides necessary WILD for upcoming MMED and Industry Staking systems.
,
Enhances user engagement with exclusive Wheels holder rewards.
,
Gives Wheels DAO members a more project-aligned asset.
,

 Cons
Requires coordination between the Wheels DAO and Wilder World Foundation.
,
Reward timelines and game launch dates are subject to final confirmation.
,

 VOTE & NOTES 
A vote will be held via Snapshot for Wilder Wheels DAO members:

Proposal is Available: Thursday, November 7, 2024
,
Vote Poll Opens: Thursday, November 14, 2024
,
Vote Poll Closes: Thursday, November 21, 2024
,
Each Wheels NFT represents one vote
,
3% quorum (191 total votes required to pass)
,
Majority (the most votes wins)
,

 Check out the proposal site here: Wheels DAO Proposal

  For full details and FAQs, please visit the Wheels DAO Wiki page. We encourage all members to share their feedback and join the conversation!

  Please head over to the ⁠No Access channel if you have any questions or feedback on the proposal. Thank you  

  Blessings @everyone,
Team Wilder

MARKETPLACE UPDATE: BOOSTING SALES WITH NEW LIQUIDITY ALLOCATION 

 Greetings Wilders  

 We’re excited to share exciting news that sets the Wilder World Marketplace apart as the premier place to trade your Wilder assets.

 To boost trading in WILD, we’ll be adding project liquidity to the Wilder World Marketplace over the coming months. 

 Wilder World Marketplace 

  How Our Liquidity Allocation Will Work
Over the next several months, WILD liquidity will be dedicated to purchasing floor-priced items listed in WILD across all Industries.
,
Items will be selected based on pricing, type and industry.
,
WILD liquidity will be both from the project, as well as founders purchasing assets directly.
,

 Advantages of Trading on the Wilder World Marketplace
No Platform Fees: Unlike OpenSea, Wilder World’s marketplace has zero platform fees, allowing sellers to keep an additional 2.5% per sale!
,
Fueling the $WILD Economy: Trading on our marketplace directly supports and strengthens Wilder World’s infrastructure by fueling the $WILD token economy.
,
In-House Platform Growth: Our marketplace lets us innovate and build in-house, reducing reliance on third-party platforms and ensuring a Wilder-driven experience.
,
Increased Sales for Floor-Listed Items: The added liquidity will drive more activity for floor listings, leading to quicker sales.
,

  Note: A 5% royalty is now enforced at the contract level across all marketplaces, ensuring that proceeds from sales continue to support and grow the Wilder World ecosystem. Please keep in mind that these royalties are essential for supporting the project, and are sent to Industry DAOs as well as the main Wilder World DAO. 

 Please continue to share your feedback in the ⁠No Access channel. For assistance, please open a ⁠No Access ticket, and a member of the community team will be happy to help.

 Thank you for your continued support, Wilders.

 Blessings @everyone,
Team Wilder (edited)

text:
SECURITY ALERT: $WILD TOKEN EXPLOIT IDENTIFIED 

 Greetings Wilders 

The Wilder World team has been made aware of an exploit involving an old ZNS (Zero Name Service) deployer wallet. 

 Here’s what we know:

What Happened:
The Wilder World team has identified an exploit involving an old ZNS (Zero Name Service) deployer wallet. The compromised deployer wallet initiated an upgrade, which enabled unauthorized transfer requests to approximately 30 wallets.
,
These wallets had active $WILD token approvals from past interactions, such as older sale or mintlist interaction.
,

What Was Affected:
The exploit specifically targeted certain $WILD tokens in affected wallets. We believe this to be a small subset of WILD holders. Other tokens and NFTs have not been moved, and the wallets themselves do not appear to be compromised. However, affected users should stop using these wallets for $WILD as the approvals tied to the upgraded contracts allow the attacker to drain newly added tokens. In an ideal scenario it would be good to stop using these wallets all together and transfer wallets to cold storage.
,


 Action Steps: 
,
To safeguard your assets, we strongly encourage ALL Wilders to follow these steps immediately:

Revoke Token Approvals:
Use trusted tools like Etherscan Token Approval Checker.
,
Check all wallet approvals and revoke any old or unnecessary permissions, especially for $WILD.
,
Stay Vigilant:
Avoid sending $WILD to compromised wallets.
,
Regularly review and clean up wallet token approvals to maintain good wallet hygiene.
,
It is a best practice to use a hot wallet for contract interactions, and completely separate cold storage for assets you hold. This is the only way to truly protect yourself if you are interacting with lots of different types of code.
,
Learn More:
If you’re unfamiliar with revoking token approvals, community members and team representatives are here to help!
,
Reach out in the ⁠No Access or ask a team member for assistance.
,

Renumeration:
Wilder World will refund any Wilders impacted by these events 100%. Our target is to start  facilitating this as soon as tomorrow (January 14, 2025).
,
In order to process wallets we will need a new wallet to send the WILD reimbursement to that is secure and uncompromised. We will share details on how new wallets will be collected when the refund process starts.
,

Looking Ahead:
Our team is actively investigating the situation and will provide necessary updates at the appropriate time.

  Thank you for your patience, understanding, and vigilance as we address this matter.

 Blessing @everyone,
Team Wilder

text:
CONCLUDING THE ODYSSEY: WILDER WORLD DAO VOTE     

  Greetings Wilders  

  On April 3rd, we announced an important proposal to hold a Wilder World DAO vote on the best way to definitively conclude The Odyssey rewards program. 


  WHY IS THIS IMPORTANT? 
The Odyssey began as a three-part community rewards campaign to engage, create, and explore. While we initially had high hopes for the program, the spirit of The Odyssey changed as large-scale farming and bot activity took hold, making it harder to fairly reward real participants. In addition to these challenges, broader market conditions also shifted, pushing us to reassess how we design a sustainable, community-aligned rewards system moving forward. 

Given that there are many perspectives on how The Odyssey should be concluded, we feel it is important to hold a Wilder World DAO vote on the best way to definitively end the program.

  Full Proposal Details can be seen here: The Odyssey DAO Vote Wiki Page


  FINAL PARTICIPANT LISTS
The Mission Pool (Shards)
A final review has now been conducted, during which all remaining Sybil accounts were removed. 
The Keepers Pool (WShards)
As promised, stacked multipliers have been applied to eligible participants, as well as the 2.5x multiplier for Shards earned via the Mission Pool.

 Final Lists: We’re currently reviewing the final numbers and will publish the final Shards and wShards lists on Wiki here.


  PROPOSAL AND EXECUTION DETAILS
We’ve been listening to community feedback and have included three options for the community to vote on:

  Option 1: Remove All Rewards from The Odyssey
Rewards will not be distributed for the Odyssey Campaign.
,
The full WILD allocation originally earmarked for this campaign will instead be redirected toward future reward programs that prioritise more sustainable, Sybil-resistant engagement systems.
,

  Option 2: Reduce the Pool to 1.5 Million WILD
We will distribute a total of 1.5 million WILD to eligible participants.
,
The distribution will be split with 60% allocated to the Keepers Pool and 40% to the Mission Pool.
,
WILD will be directly airdropped to participants on Z Chain or Ethereum, depending on L1 Gas fees.
,

  Option 3: Reduce the Pool to 3 Million WILD
We will distribute a total of 3 million WILD to eligible participants.
,
The distribution will be split with 60% allocated to the Keepers Pool and 40% to the Mission Pool.
,
WILD will be directly airdropped to participants on Z Chain or Ethereum, depending on L1 Gas fees.
,


  VOTES & NOTES
The vote is held via Snapshot for Wilder World DAO members (WILD holders).

Vote Poll Opens: April 26th, 2025.
,
Vote Poll Closes: May 3rd, 2025
,
Each WILD token held represents one vote.
,
A 10% quorum is required to pass.
,
Majority (the most votes wins).
,

  Vote Here: Snapshot Website

  We thank you for your continued support, Wilders. 

  Blessings @everyone,
Team Wilder

 Greetings Wilders 

 Following yesterday’s Operation Titan announcement, today, we’re launching a series of DAO proposals where existing ETH funds would be used to purchase WILD token on the spot market. The ETH obtained through the swaps will be used to buy back WILD on the open market. This is a powerful mechanism designed to reduce sell pressure, drive token demand, and increase long-term holder value as the Wilder economy expands.

 Proposal: DAOs allocate 100% of their ETH treasury to swap for WILD

 Full details of each DAO proposal and accompanying FAQs can be found on the Wiki: Strengthening the WILD Token Economy 

 We are submitting proposals for the Wheels, Beasts, Kicks, Cribs, Crafts, Moto, Land, and PALs DAOs to allocate their full ETH treasuries to swap for WILD from the Wilder World Marketing and Liquidity allocation. 

 There will be separate token-gated votes for each DAO to ensure that only eligible holders can participate: Genesis asset holders for the Industry DAOs, and WILD token holders for the Wilder World DAO. 

KEY INFORMATION

 Option A: Swap ETH for WILD
DAOs swap 100% their ETH for WILD, from the Marketing & Liquidity allocations. The WILD is sent directly to the DAO treasury, and the ETH is used to buy back WILD on the open market.

No ETH is swapped or used.

text:
THE EVOLUTION OF DIGITAL IDENTITIY - ZNS v2.0    

 Greetings Wilders  

  Today, we announce the next major evolution of the Zero Name Service (ZNS): a comprehensive upgrade that goes beyond technical improvements to represent a new approach to digital identity ownership.

 The transition from ZNS v1.0 to v2.0 isn't just about updating code; it's about building a better foundation for how we own, manage, and express our digital identities. This upgrade reflects our commitment to decentralization, user sovereignty, and empowering creators in the digital economy.

 Read the full ZINE here: THE EVOLUTION OF DIGITAL IDENTITIY

 Summary of Key Info  
 ZNS upgrades from v1.0 → v2.0 with a full redesign of digital identity ownership.
 New features: unified ownership, stateless pricing, hierarchical controls, emergency pause, bulk registration, string resolution, gas efficiency.
 Migration moves ZNS from Ethereum → Z Chain, purpose-built for the creator economy.
 All staked payments from v1 are fully refunded in original tokens (WILD, MEOW, etc.).
 All domains and ownership records migrate to Z Chain, but configs (pricing, payment, operators, mintlists) do not.
 ZNS v1 on Ethereum will be frozen and deprecated.
 Important Dates

Aug 25, 2025 → Migration starts, ZNS v1 frozen.
,
Aug 28, 2025 → Domains migrated to Z Chain.
,
Aug 29, 2025 → Registration + updates reopen on Z Chain.

LEGEND OF THE WILD $100K TOURNAMENT: QUALIFIERS LAUNCH TOMORROW!    

 Greetings Wilders  

  It’s the final day of Pre-Qualifiers and your last chance to get matches in before the real battle begins! 

 We’ve made some key changes to the tournament based on community feedback. Full tournament details and rules can be found here on Wiki: Legend of the WILD Wiki

  Let's spread the word by sharing this Wilder World X post

To ensure a smooth and fair experience, we’re adding a grace period between the Qualifiers and Playoffs, and again between the Playoffs and Finals, giving us time to update the build and analyse data before the next stage begins.

 New Tournament Dates
 • Qualifiers: Sept 2nd (6 AM PT) → Sept 12th (6 AM PT)
 • Playoffs: Sept 15th – 18th
 • Finals: Sept 24th

 Eligible Server Regions
During the Pre-Qualifiers, each region had to hit 100+ active players to unlock the Qualifiers. The regions that have progressed are:
 •  Europe
 •  USA
 •  Brazil
If your region didn’t qualify, you can still compete by joining matches on any of the active regional servers.

 In-Game Match Flow
 Here’s what to expect when you drop into the Qualifiers:
 • Warmup Phase: Matches start with a warmup lasting up to 10 minutes (or until 8 players join). XP still counts during this phase.
 • Tournament Match Trigger: Once 8+ players are in the lobby, a 1-minute grace period begins so everyone can get ready.
 • Tournament Match: After the grace period, tournament scoring activates automatically. No respawn reset, just keep playing!
 • Match End: Matches run for 10 minutes, or end early if a player reaches 30 kills.
 • Scoring: Tournament score uses uncapped XP (kills, headshots, assists, streaks all matter). Your best 10 matches will count toward your final leaderboard position.
The Qualifiers will begin after the leaderboards are reset tomorrow, Tuesday, September 2, 2025 at 9:00 AM.

 Good luck, Wilders! It’s time to carve your name into Wilder history and rise as a true Legend of the WILD 

 Blessings @everyone,
Team Wilder

SIMULATION OS ROADMAP: THE FINAL FRONTIER    

 Greetings Wilders  

The OS Simulation roadmap laid a solid foundation and we achieved some incredible milestones. Now, as we move through the remainder of Act III, we want to provide a high level overview with a new wave of updates. Some of these milestones were not part of the original map, but they are true game changers. Each one expands the vision of the Simulation, accelerating progress and opening new ways for players to connect, create, and compete inside Wilder World.

 Read the full ZINE here: Simulation OS Roadmap - The Final Frontier

 Metropolis 2.0: The WILD Smart Contract Upgrade introduces a burn function.
 Onchain Interactions: Daily Check-Ins are now live, rewarding Wilders with 3 WILD each day directly in Super Early Access.

 Wilder Packs: Pack sales will launch soon, offering tradable, onchain items that impact gameplay and progression.
 Avatar Creator:  The journey to identity begins.
 Garage: Upgrade, tune, and style your Wheels with performance and cosmetic parts powered by ownership.

 With each cycle, the Simulation evolves.

Hi @everyone,

There has been a large liquidation event on Peapods, which has triggered a cascading series of liquidations across positions. The project remains in a strong financial position, this event will not affect operations and is isolated to temporary price impact.

We are actively monitoring the situation and will provide updates as soon as we have more clarity. Please remain patient as we assess the impact and coordinate next steps.

Thank you.

Official update from n3o:

 Emergency Update: WILD Flash Crash

At approximately 07:45 UTC, $WILD experienced a rapid flash crash that is still undergoing.

This was not caused by any security breach or exploit, but rather by a cascading liquidation event originating from the WILD PeaPods lending pool.

In short, our integration with PeaPods carried unanticipated systemic risk that we did not understand. Unfortunately, this became evident under extreme market conditions, triggering forced liquidations and a sharp price decline.

Key Points:


There was no hack, no compromise of user funds, and no failure of Wilder World’s core systems.
,
The liquidation cycle is still in progress, but we expect the market to stabilize once it completes.
,
The project maintains sufficient runway (12–24 months) to continue full development regardless of token price or near-term capital inflows.
,
The team remains fully committed to building Wilder World’s long-term vision.
,

We understand this event is deeply unsettling. Transparency and accountability are our top priorities.

A detailed incident report and community AMA will be held within 48 hours to walk through exactly what happened, what we’ve learned, and what happens next.

I want to reiterate that this will not stop us and our plans for the next sixty days and year do not change.

To our long-term supporters: thank you for standing with us through this extreme volatility. We believe in the fundamentals of WILD and the strength of the Wilder community.

n3o

LEGEND OF THE WILD TOURNAMENT UPDATES    

 Greetings Wilders  

 Thank you to everyone who has taken part in the tournament. It’s been a WILD ride so far! We’d like to share some important updates on the Live Finals and Prize Distribution.

 THE FINALS 
Huge congrats once again to our six finalists, who’ve each secured a Golden Ticket for an all-expenses-paid trip to compete live on stage, for the title of Legend of the WILD.  

 We’re excited to reveal that the Tournament Finals will take place at TOKEN2049, Dubai, in April 2026. 
 Our finalists will be flown from their home countries across Russia, the US, and Europe to face off in the ultimate showdown.
 The original plan was to host the Grand Finale in the US next month, but due to travel and visa limitations in some cases, we’ve chosen Dubai as a new central location that allows all finalists to attend and compete in person.
 Finalists will be asked to open a support ticket once travel coordination begins.

 PRIZE DISTRIBUTION 
Congratulations to all of our tournament winners! Every eligible competitor will receive a WILD prize based on their placement.

 All prizes up to the finals will be distributed by early next month in WILD on Z Chain to your wallet affiliated with your Epic Games player account. Please make sure your ZERO account is connected, and your ZERO and EPIC accounts are linked, so rewards can be delivered smoothly.

 Funding for Operation Wildfire content prizes has been received in the community wallet, and distribution for these prizes will begin over the weekend.

 OUTSTANDING ITEMS  

MMED: We’re processing the MMED rewards list and will distribute funds shortly after tournament prizes. The exact date will be announced alongside the tournament prize update.
,
Odyssey List: All Typeform disputes have been reviewed and the list updated. A final QC is underway, and the list will be published this month.
,
MEOW Airdrop: Completing the MEOW airdrop is the final task on the list. The airdrop will include any missed rewards from the first round, plus the additional allocation for WILD stakers as promised.
,

 Stay tuned with ⁠📰│major-announcements for full details coming soon.

 We appreciate your continued support and can’t wait to see everyone at the Live Finals in Dubai, where one Wilder will be crowned the ultimate Legend of the WILD.

 Blessings @everyone,
Team Wilder

OPEN WORLD PREVIEW DROPPING DEC 19TH     

  Greetings Wilders  

  As we gear up for the much-anticipated Open World preview, we wanted to let you know that we are targeting a release date of December 19th, subject to Epic approval.

  The Open World preview will introduce the first look at Wiami as a living, breathing city. You’ll jump into missions, hunt down the Forum, and explore early versions of dynamic interiors, traffic, and NPC behavior. You’ll also get a taste of the core gameplay loop that ties driving, combat, and discovery together.

  Open World testers will be a carefully selected group of Wilders who have stood by the project from the beginning, alongside some of our more recent community members who are highly active, engaged, and supportive. 

  We will be inviting around 250 Wilders to test Open World, releasing access in controlled waves of roughly 50 testers at a time. This staggered rollout allows us to monitor stability, gather focused feedback, and resolve key issues between each wave, ensuring the experience improves steadily as more Wilders enter Wiami.

  Full details on the rollout, application process, and criteria for consideration, can be seen in this ZINE - Open World: Rollout Overview

  The Open World preview will mark the beginning of the largest and most anticipated milestone for Wilder World.

  Get ready to step into Wiami like never before. This is where the real journey begins!

 Blessings @everyone,
Team Wilder

 Greetings Wilders  

 Today marks one of the most defining moments in Wilder history, a moment Wilders have been waiting years to experience.

  The Open World Preview is live!

 Help us celebrate by spreading the word far and wide. Like, comment, and repost to share this epic news with the world:

Single-player exploration and combat against Forum forces (multiplayer will follow in later phases).

The foundation of Packs, introducing seasonal, on-chain assets tied to missions and progression.

text:
IMPORTANT UPDATE: CHANGES TO WILDER DISCORD 

 Greetings Wilders  

Over the past few weeks, Wilder World has undergone a major shift.

As shared on X, we are transitioning into an AI-first studio, building faster and setting the foundation for long-term sustainability in a rapidly changing world.

Alongside this evolution, we’re changing how our community connects.


 What’s Changing
Discord has been a core part of Wilder World since 2021 and we’re incredibly grateful for everything built here. As we evolve, we’re moving toward a more streamlined and integrated communication system.

 Discord will transition to a read-only announcements channel
 Community chat and discussion will move to ZERO
 Discord support tickets will be closing

Support will shift to a dedicated email-based system, allowing us to better manage and respond to requests.


 ZERO: The New Hub
Going forward, ZERO becomes the center of the Wilder community.

We’re actively building features based on your feedback, including:
 • Search across conversations
 • Message pinning
 • Role-based communities

This is just the beginning. ZERO will continue to evolve as a core part of the ecosystem.


 Timeline
These changes will go live on: Friday, March 27

Until then:
 • Discord channels and support tickets remain open
 • You’ll have time to transition and get set up on ZERO


 What This Means
This is a shift towards a more integrated future for Wilder World.

The community remains at the core of everything we’re building. Your voice, feedback and participation will continue to shape what comes next. 

More updates will come soon, as we roll out new features, products and experiences across Wilder World.

Blessings @everyone,
Team Wilder

IMPORTANT UPDATE: CHANGES TO WILDER DISCORD 

 Hello Wilders  

After community feedback following last week’s announcement that we would be moving Discord to read-only, it’s clear the community is passionate about keeping Discord open.

We’ve decided to keep Discord open in a limited capacity.

Moving forward as of Friday, March 27th:
    •    The general channel will remain open
    •    The announcements channel will remain active
    •    The majority of engagement and activity will still move to ZERO

  There will be limited oversight and moderation from the team, so we ask that the community stays active in monitoring the Discord and takes full responsibility for any security risks that come with participating moving forward.

 Customer Support
Support will be shifting to a dedicated email-based system, allowing us to better manage and respond to your requests. If you need any assistance, please reach out to us at:
 inquire@wilderworld.com

Appreciate everyone speaking up and riding with us.

Blessings @everyone,
Team Wilder

GAME RELEASE 0.12.0 — THE CUSTOMIZATION UPDATE IS LIVE

Today marks a significant moment in Wilder World's development. We're shipping the Customization Update, the first major build to put your identity directly in your hands inside Wiami.

Avatar customization, loadout systems, and vehicle mods aren't just cosmetic additions, they're the foundation that the open world economy is built on. Every pack item you hold becomes part of how you show up in Wiami.

 Need new gear? packs.wilderworld.com 

───

 Avatar Customization

• Default Spawn — Avatars spawn with standard undersuit, helmet, and goggles
• Full Customization — Equip any gear from your inventory: Helmets, Chest Armor, Thigh Guards, Boots & Undersuits

───

 Weaponry & Attachments

• Soulbound Starter — Empty inventory? You spawn with a default Soulbound weapon. You're never defenseless.
• Custom Loadouts — Own weapons and attachments? Fully customize primary and secondary before dropping in.

───

 Vehicle Customization & Performance
Your garage just got a lot more technical. Modify your vehicles using parts from your inventory to gain an edge.

• Performance Tuning — Improve engine output and vehicle stats
• System Upgrades — Install intake systems, fuel systems, electrical components

We've also added over 20 brand-new vehicles to the garage.

───

⚡️ Inventory Optimization
Menu speeds have been significantly improved. Your entire collection now loads in 2-3 seconds. Inventory sorting across categories and rarity is now live.

───

 How We Ship Now

Previously, we delayed builds to fix small issues and polish minor details. This pushed release windows by 1-2 weeks at a time.

We're changing that.

Starting with 0.12.0, Wilder World ships on a rapid iterative cadence. Builds ship when stable. Known non-game-breaking issues are documented in patch notes and fixed in the next release. Game-breaking issues are the only hard blocker.

Faster releases. More frequent updates. A game that evolves more rapidly.

───

 Known Issues in This Build

None are game-breaking. All are tracked for the next release:

• Trinity Sentinel Helmet toggle not working
• Soulbound icon missing from loadout UI
• Gear item color toggling unexpectedly
• Some red dot weapon sights slightly off-center
• Duplicate attachment equip possible on two weapons

SEASON ZERO: THE INVASION IS LIVE

The Forum took the streets. Now they're holding your loot. The full extraction loop is live in Wiami: drop in, clear Breaches, fill your backpack, get out alive. Runs off-chain on test currency, so the stakes are real without touching your wallet. When the season ends, your MILD and earned gear wipe and your onchain assets return.

  The Rule
Cargo is only yours once you secure it. MILD locks when you bank it, Shards lock once extracted into gear and stored. Die before then and it drops for other Wilders to grab. Your loadout survives, so you respawn and run again.

 The Loop
Spawn into a live instance, up to 6 Wilders on the same streets. Clear Breaches, kill agents, loot. Then make the trip back to Agora Alley: bank MILD at the ATM, extract Shards into gear at the Neural Station, store it. No limit on how long you stay in. The longer you run, the more you carry and the more you lose if you don't make it out.

 The Main Scene
 Repair · Refuel · NOS — service your car or it won't survive the next drop
 Relay 24 — stock Health and Ammo before you drop
 Bank MILD — banked is safe, even if you die later
 Extract Shards — convert to gear at the Neural Station
 Store It — no checkpoint to Storage, so it isn't safe until it clears

 Inventories
Loadout never drops. Backpack is all at risk. Storage is untouchable. Cargo only rides in the backpack, secure it by banking MILD or extracting and storing Shards. Sizes locked for Season Zero.

 Z Vision
Hold ALT for a heat mapping view to scan your surroundings and read a Breach before you push.

 Respawning
Die and you wake at the Nexus Medical Center with your car. Backpack stays where you fell, loadout and ride come back. Death only costs what you were carrying.

 XP & Ranks
XP is your rank and leaderboard spot, never lost. Kills, assists, time, loot all pay, even on a failed run. Extraction adds +100 XP. XP buys rank only, no gear, no power.

Everyone resets to Bronze:

 Bronze →  Silver →  Gold →  Platinum →  Diamond →  WILD

Five ranks of 1,000, five subranks of 200 each. WILD opens at 5,000, no cap.

 The Handshake
No teams. Meet a Wilder and you choose: shake hands or take the shot. Killing pays zero XP, you only get their cargo, and you still have to extract it. Every kill makes you a bigger target.

 Carried
MILD banks at the ATM. Shards convert to gear, six rarities up to WILD. Consumables (Health, Ammo) live now. Lose a run and all of it drops for whoever finds you first.

  Ownable Agents run while you're offline
  Satin Passage player market
 Garages, Apartments & Armory
 Deeper Breaches (Droid, HydroLink)

The Forum thinks the city is theirs. Go take it back.
